about: Gun mods are chosen by uniqueName, never by name (G11/G31). A rule denies a mod when its uniqueName contains `path_contains`, unless its name starts with `unless_name_starts`. `allow` lists mods kept regardless (`id` = uniqueName), each with its reason. Refresh fails on a gun-mod name still duplicated after filtering.

rules.reason: low-rank starter copy of a normal mod
mid-rank copy of a normal mod
non-Primed /Expert/ copy with higher values; not in the game or on the wiki (Marcos, 2026-11-07)
Conclave (PvP) mod; cannot be equipped outside Conclave

allow.name: Double Tap
allow.reason: Conclave mod that also works outside Conclave (DE text: "Stacks up to 20x outside of Conclave"); Marcos, 2026-11-08
